relationships.subject: iloprost
relationships.evidence_quote: This property may reflect its ability to inhibit CXCL10, a known, early contributor to SSc-associated vasculopathy

relationships.subject: ozone
relationships.evidence_quote: The reported upregulation of growth factors such as VEGF and TGFβ in local ulcer tissue after ozone treatment may promote epithelialization

key_findings: Review: prostacyclin analogues and endothelin antagonists (bosentan) are main treatments for systemic sclerosis digital ulcers; macitentan and riociguat trials failed primary endpoints.
